Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 39 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vinod - 38 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Ishaan - 8 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
5. Meera - 13 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Anjali, Vinod and Ishaan stand near him.]

Vinod: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aditya sings a song.]

Aditya: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Aditya scratches his head.]

Ishaan: "Really?"

[Aditya coughs.]

Aditya: "Dad, are you okay?"

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Anjali: "Hmm, I see."

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Aditya: "Show me too!"

[Aditya pats his horse.]

Aditya: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
